title: Robust mixed-state SLD-QFIM probe design
difficulty_explanation: The solver must differentiate a noisy mixed-state circuit, form stable three-parameter SLD-QFIMs on fixed support, and optimize a robust log-determinant objective across an ensemble.
claim_boundary: The exact tracked module-scope-JIT expert passed every functional, scientific, static, and strict expert-admission metric in a public-default, network-disabled direct canary of the exact schedule-scrubbed, oracle-prebound evaluator. The separately tracked direct-canary record binds the final materialized task and preserved ignored raw-output hashes without changing this task contract. The evaluator precomputes all hidden ensembles before solution import and emits no private schedule afterward. This is a direct pinned canary only, not an authenticated Harbor run or admission record. No private prequalification set, human promotion, LLM-policy audit, or GPT-5.6-sol trial has run on this exact bundle, and difficulty remains a hypothesis.

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: A verifier base seed b expands to the ordered three-instance schedule (b, b + 12, b + 30). An explicit --seeds schedule is accepted only in that form and cannot override a verifier-authorized base seed.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: The schedule mapping is runtime-independent. The evaluator hashes the ordered exact public configs passed to the three solution calls; hidden theta/noise draws and independent oracle results are excluded.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, finite ndarray/scalar normalization, and full numeric values over the ordered exact public configs; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line and flushes it before untrusted import.
seed_protocol.seed_scrub: The evaluator constructs all hidden ensembles before importing untrusted code, then removes ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED and replaces sys.argv with the evaluator program name immediately after emitting case identity. It does not print the private schedule or invoke seeded RNG between solution calls.
seed_protocol.trusted_dependency_binding: The evaluator default-binds its numerical oracle chain and captures the evaluator callable, clock, output/JSON functions, aggregators, thresholds, and exit callable before solution import. This blocks tested __main__ name replacement and clock spoofing but is not full same-process hostile isolation.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6 and SciPy 1.17.1; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.

scientific_contract.objective: worst-case logdet(F + 0.04 I) with a minimum-eigenvalue gate

tensorcircuit_central_path: TensorCircuit DMCircuit for every noisy sensing state
JAX derivatives through DMCircuit density matrices
independent_oracle: NumPy/SciPy density propagation, finite differences, spectral SLD formula, and a separate vectorized SLD equation
hardcoding_resistance: arbitrary nonnegative verifier base-seed schedules of the required (b, b + 12, b + 30) form

expert_admission_protocol.threshold_policy_binding: The generic trusted score_submission harness canonicalizes these ordered metric/direction/threshold rows and records their SHA-256 in expert-admission.json. Every observed metric must have a strict positive margin.

validation.validation_scope: The separate direct-canary record binds the exact materialized task, pinned-image functional stdout, host static-policy output, and runtime-version evidence; authenticated Harbor evidence is pending.

prior_unpreserved_current_byte_observati.evidence_scope: corroborating direct observation only; the separately tracked canary record is the durable current evidence

prior_unpreserved_scientific_formula_can.evidence_scope: historical formula cross-check only; the current direct-canary record proves the evaluator-emitted SLD identity metric, not these two separate maxima

pre_privacy_hardening_module_scope_jit_o.evidence_scope: scientific/runtime corroboration only; post-import schedule logging and between-call seeded RNG were later removed
byte-identical expert temp-path corroboration only; not exact current evaluator evidence
post-import schedule print removed, but hidden seeded ensembles were not yet precomputed before untrusted code

previous_unhoisted_jit_expert_observatio.reason: Fresh nested JIT functions forced repeated compilation for the three same-shape instances; module-scope JIT reuse removes that overhead without changing the optimizer, objective, starts, iteration count, QFIM formula, evaluator, or thresholds.

pre_protocol_predecessor_observation.evidence_scope: historical predecessor evaluator only; not evidence for the upgraded protocol bundle

previous_rejected_expert.reason: The original expert optimized only the four supplied theta points and selected by training minimum eigenvalue, overfitting seed 101051. The replacement uses a deterministic public-box design ensemble and hard robust-score selection without changing evaluator gates.

admission_blockers: Run one authenticated pinned expert-only Harbor admission on a reviewed seed and retain the case digest, threshold-policy hash, evaluator/task hashes, 160-line result, and strict runtime margin; the public direct canary record is feasibility evidence only.
Prequalify at least 25 private seed/digest records in the pinned image with runtime, memory, fixed-support, robust-gain, minimum-QFIM, and formula-agreement margins.

Before any solver pilot, derive the hidden ensemble from an independent verifier-only seed or isolated precomputed artifact rather than the PCG64 stream that also generates solver-visible public configuration; same-process submitted-solution isolation remains incomplete.
Complete human physics/framework/independent review plus authenticated expert Harbor functional, static, and LLM-policy audit before any solver manifest.
One clean GPT-5.6-sol/high pass vetoes this frozen design; failures require two independent substantive-failure auditors.
api_risks: DMCircuit.depolarizing(px, py, pz) and densitymatrix() are required and were canaried only against tensorcircuit-nightly 1.7.0.dev20260618.
The expert requests JAX x64 and TensorCircuit complex128; a build that disables x64 can lose SLD stability.
The independent oracle assumes TensorCircuit's RXX/RYY/RZZ convention exp(-i theta P/2) and leftmost qubit-0 tensor ordering.
Differentiating through a 16x16 complex linear solve exercises higher-order JAX autodiff and is the primary compilation risk.
